$description: Web-terminal-only extension tokens: CRT-effect gates, the ASCII welcome modal's own muted-sage palette, and (added by Task 1.7 when the real build surfaced them as a gap) four theme-independent layout/motion constants plus one color tint that variables.css/theme-light.css define but Task 1.1 never tokenized — all four are live dependencies of scaffold.css/operator.css/terminal.css/files.css/settings.css/drawer.css/sessions.css/md-rendered.css/session.html (60+ call sites), so they cannot simply be dropped when those files are deleted. Namespaced --wt-* like every other extension here, deliberately NOT left as bare names (--header-height etc.) despite that costing a rename at every call site — bare names would reopen exactly the flat-namespace collision risk the wt-/art-/ariel-/lat-/cf- convention exists to close, and namespace-collision is a validated invariant (validate.py's check_namespace_collisions). Structured as top-level dark/light groups (one hop into core.json primitives, mirroring tokens/themes/*.json) — NOT semantic tokens, so they're namespaced --wt-* on emission. Source: web_terminal/static/css/variables.css + theme-light.css. Every theme authors its own group here — nothing inherits. wt-crt is a flat gate held at 0/none by every group except retro-dark, kept rather than deleted because operator.css/safety.css/session.css still reference its vars and a dropped var would fall back to opacity 1 (re-showing the scanline). The retro-dark/retro-light groups are the pre-redesign values preserved verbatim (live CRT gates, 48px header, 24px status bar), so the opt-in retro family restores the old look through the same vars the flat themes hold at 0/none. The high-contrast groups repeat the main groups' flat chrome and re-express their two color-bearing entries (wt-welcome, wt-accent-system-tint-04) on the achromatic mono ramp, because that family is fully monochrome and an inherited accent would be the only hue left on the page.

scanline-opacity.$description: Neutralized flat gate (was 1): the redesign strips the CRT aesthetic in both themes. Kept at 0 rather than deleted because operator.css/safety.css/session.css still reference this var; an undefined opacity would fall back to 1 and re-show the scanline.

glow-opacity.$description: Neutralized flat gate (was 1) — drives operator streaming glow and safety.css color-mix glows to zero.

bezel-shadow.$description: Neutralized (was an inset CRT bezel shadow).

glow-shadow.$description: Active-terminal inner glow — none in the flat themes; the retro groups carry the pre-redesign accent-tinted inset.

wt-welcome.$description: The ASCII welcome banner keeps its green-phosphor CRT treatment in every chromatic theme, including the flat ones. It is the product's signature intro surface rather than part of the shell chrome, so it is deliberately NOT re-tinted to follow the redesign palette — this group and the retro-* groups carry the same values on purpose. Only the high-contrast groups depart from it, because that family admits no hue at all.

text-glow.$description: Composite text-shadow embedding green.200's rgb triplet at 25% alpha; kept literal (no one-hop alias expresses 'primitive + alpha').

scanline-bg.$description: The welcome ASCII banner's own, more-pronounced scanline effect — distinct from wt-crt.scanline-bg (different stop offsets and alpha). Theme-invariant by design (same value in every group, matching the literal it replaces): the overlay's opacity is gated by wt-crt.scanline-opacity, which is 0 in every non-retro group, so this value never renders visibly outside the retro family regardless.

wt-header-height.$description: Header bar height (frame 2a). Renamed from --header-height (Task 1.1 omission surfaced by the real build; used by terminal.css).

wt-status-bar-height.$description: Status footer height (frame 2a). Renamed from --status-bar-height (used by terminal.css, files.css).

wt-transition-fast.$description: Renamed from --transition-fast; full transition shorthand (duration + easing), not a bare duration, so kept as a literal string rather than aliasing core.json's duration.instant primitive. Used 50+ times across drawer.css/terminal.css/files.css/settings.css/operator.css/md-rendered.css/scaffold.css/sessions.css/session.html.

wt-transition-normal.$description: Renamed from --transition-normal; same shorthand rationale as wt-transition-fast. Used by terminal.css, files.css, scaffold.css, session.html.

wt-accent-system-tint-04.$description: A one-off accent.base-derived tint distinct from the tint.accent.* scale; used by operator.css. Re-based onto this theme's own accent (azure.300 #6e9fff) — it had been left on the pre-redesign teal accent when the palette was remapped, which made the operator console's system rows the one teal-tinted surface in an otherwise blue-accented theme.

bg.$description: Equals the pre-redesign light bg.primary — welcome modal has no CRT vignette in light mode, so it just matches that background.

scanline-bg.$description: Same theme-invariant value as dark — see dark group's description.

wt-header-height.$description: Header bar height (frame 2a) — theme-independent, identical to dark's value.

wt-status-bar-height.$description: Status footer height (frame 2a) — theme-independent, identical to dark's value.

wt-transition-fast.$description: Theme-independent motion constant — identical to dark's value.

wt-transition-normal.$description: Theme-independent motion constant — identical to dark's value.

wt-accent-system-tint-04.$description: This theme's own accent.base (azure.500 #1f62c4) at the same 4% alpha as dark's — re-based off the pre-redesign teal for the same reason given in the dark group.

desy-dark.$description: The `desy` family repeats the main family's flat chrome verbatim (neutralized CRT gates, phosphor welcome banner, same layout/motion constants) and departs from it in exactly one entry: wt-accent-system-tint-04, which is accent-bearing and so must track this family's own accent. It cannot use $extensions.inherits for that reason — inherits is all-or-nothing per mode group.

wt-accent-system-tint-04.$description: This theme's own accent.base (cyan.300 #009fdf, the DESY brand cyan) at the same 4% alpha the other groups use.
This theme's own accent.base (cyan.450 #0077c4, the nudged DESY accessibility cyan) at the same 4% alpha the other groups use.

scanline-opacity.$description: Pre-redesign value: the CRT scanline renders under retro-dark.

glow-shadow.$description: The pre-redesign active-terminal inner glow: 60px inset of the old teal accent-tint-04 (rgba of accent.light #4fd1c5 at 4%).

text-glow.$description: Composite text-shadow embedding green.200's rgb triplet at 25% alpha; kept literal (no one-hop alias expresses 'primitive + alpha').

wt-header-height.$description: Pre-redesign header height, preserved with the retro family.

wt-status-bar-height.$description: Pre-redesign status footer height, preserved with the retro family.

scanline-opacity.$description: The pre-redesign light theme was already CRT-quiet (opacity gates at 0) — preserved as-is.

glow-shadow.$description: The old active-terminal glow was NOT opacity-gated — it rendered in light mode too, as the old light accent-tint-04. Preserved for faithfulness.

bg.$description: Equals the old light bg.primary — welcome modal has no CRT vignette in light mode, so it just matches the page background.

wt-header-height.$description: Pre-redesign header height, preserved with the retro family.

wt-status-bar-height.$description: Pre-redesign status footer height, preserved with the retro family.

wt-welcome.$description: Authored rather than inherited: the high-contrast family is fully monochrome, and the main group's welcome palette (phosphor green in dark, teal in light) would be the only hue an operator on that theme ever sees.

wt-header-height.$description: The flat chrome, identical to the main theme's — this family differs from it in color only.
